'''Se'Lenti''', translated from [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] as "'''the Scouring'''," was a term used to describe the desolation brought about on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] by the [[Corellian/Aqualish war|struggle]] between the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] for control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] resources.

==The conflict==
The desolation occurred when [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] were deliberately crashed into the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], killing some five billion [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothites]] and releasing vaporized [[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbaride]] from the crust into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].
